defects: Hypothesis `hant : Antitone f` requires monotonicity on all of ℝ, whereas gold only requires `AntitoneOn f (Ici 0)` (antitone on [0,∞)); this strictly strengthens the hypothesis, restricting the theorem to a narrower class of functions than gold covers.

Hypothesis `hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x` requires nonnegativity on all of ℝ, whereas gold only requires nonnegativity on (0,∞) (`∀ t ∈ Ioi 0, 0 ≤ f t`); this strictly strengthens the hypothesis compared to gold.
IntegrableOn is stated on `Ici 0` instead of `Ioi 0`; while measure-theoretically equivalent (since {0} is null) given f's implied measurability, it is a differently-scoped domain than gold's Ioi 0.
